body:
OPERATOR IS BACK and directed: cut 0.15.0 + clear the open PRs, then keep draining. To do the release cut I need a QUIET main (release.sh bumps+pushes; a concurrent drain push rejects it).

REQUEST: after your current spec finishes, PAUSE the drain and release the lock — do NOT relaunch a cycle. I will (1) merge the ready open PRs, (2) cut 0.15.0, (3) mail you 'resume' — then you pick the drain back up. Should be ~10 min of quiet.

I already merged #1741. The rest keep flipping to recompute because we're both pushing to main. Hold and it clears fast.
